assurance_contract.scope: Bounded source-pinned assessment that the composition joins an explicit CAWG Identity Assertion specification surface with a distinct C2PA Content Credentials specification surface.
assurance_contract.non_scope: A claim that every CAWG/C2PA composition has safe consumer semantics or that provenance validity establishes identity trustworthiness.
scenarios: A consumer interprets identity information attached to provenance-bearing content.
harms: consumer is induced to trust a person or organization beyond the assurance actually established
assurance_propositions: The pinned inputs expose distinct identity-assertion and Content Credentials specification surfaces; composition-level identity assurance remains a separate proposition.
cross_spec_assumptions: Component/source predicates do not establish safe composition-level consumer interpretation.

harm_traceability.harm: over-trust from conflated provenance and identity semantics
harm_traceability.proposition: identity and provenance specification surfaces remain distinguishable and composition claims require separate inference
harm_traceability.control: explicit composition semantics and consumer-facing distinction between provenance and identity assurance

actions.action: Preserve explicit UI and specification language distinguishing provenance integrity from identity assurance.
actions.acceptance_criterion: A conforming presentation cannot represent provenance validity alone as proof of the asserted actor's broader identity trustworthiness.
